hunks.baseline: I closed the Quest Window. It was midwinter, and I still felt like I was about to break into a cold sweat.
hunks.sol: I closed the Quest Window. It was the middle of winter, but I felt a cold sweat coming on.

hunks.baseline: The Fame that had been climbing little by little had suddenly stopped dead. That had been half a day ago. I’d bolted from my quarters and shaken hands like a presidential candidate until I was worn to the bone, but the notification I’d been waiting for never came.
hunks.sol: My Fame had been climbing little by little, only to suddenly stop dead. That had been half a day ago. I’d bolted from my quarters and gone around shaking hands like a presidential candidate until my arms nearly fell off, but the notification I was waiting for never came.

hunks.baseline: It was the System’s way of telling me I’d already milked Fame to the limit and should knock it off. Even the System seemed to find me pitiful.
hunks.sol: It was the System’s way of telling me I’d already milked all the Fame I could from this place and should knock it off. Even the System seemed to find me pitiful.

hunks.baseline: And so the day slipped away, and there was nothing I could do about it. Today was the long-awaited departure ceremony.
hunks.sol: And so an entire day slipped away with nothing to show for it. Today was the long-awaited departure ceremony.

hunks.baseline: “Fuck…”
hunks.sol: “Fuuuck…”

hunks.baseline: As I muttered the curse under my breath, Jin Wikyung was climbing onto the platform.
hunks.sol: As I muttered the curse under my breath, Jin Wikyung climbed onto the platform.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of pairs of eyes followed him. Martial artists of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, and martial artists from the small and mid-sized sects that had newly joined us. More than five hundred martial artists stood in formation across the main training ground.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of pairs of eyes followed him—the martial artists of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and those from the small and mid-sized sects that had recently joined us. More than five hundred stood in formation across the main training ground.

hunks.baseline: At some point, a tremendous rumble spread through the air. Some stamped their feet; others struck their weapons. When five hundred martial artists with internal energy moved as one, the earth shook and a roar filled heaven and earth.
hunks.sol: A tremendous rumble began to spread. Some stamped their feet; others struck their weapons. When five hundred martial artists wielding internal energy moved as one, the earth shook and a deafening roar filled heaven and earth.

hunks.baseline: I had never seen anything like it. They had gone from individuals to a single military force, and now they were waiting for one man’s command.
hunks.sol: I had never seen anything like it. No longer individuals, they had become a single army, waiting for one man’s command.

hunks.baseline: “I will not deny it. The enemy is ahead of us in troop numbers and in the number of Peak masters.”
hunks.sol: “I will not deny it. The enemy outnumbers us in both troops and Peak masters.”

hunks.baseline: Silence dropped over them in an instant. But Jin Wikyung wasn’t foolish enough to kill morale from the opening. The presence pouring off his entire body was proof of that.
hunks.sol: Silence fell in an instant. But Jin Wikyung wasn’t foolish enough to crush morale with his opening words. The force of his presence was proof of that.

hunks.baseline: His usual good-natured smile was gone without a trace. The Jin Wikyung standing before us was both a Peak martial artist and the head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
hunks.sol: His usual good-natured smile was nowhere to be seen. Right now, Jin Wikyung was both a Peak martial artist and the head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.

hunks.baseline: “They are nothing but jackals with numbers on their side. That man’s rabble—wandering martial artists blinded by gold, and a pack of mounted bandits who have plundered the common people!”
hunks.sol: “They are nothing but an overgrown pack of jackals. Common street rabble, wandering martial artists blinded by gold, and mounted bandits who prey upon innocent people!”

hunks.baseline: The air crackled under a shout that spat fire. Even I felt my blood boil, if only for that moment.
hunks.sol: The air crackled beneath his fiery shout. Even my blood seemed to boil for a moment.

hunks.baseline: The Mount Heng Sword Sect had lost the two most important things in a war.
hunks.sol: The Mount Heng Sword Sect had lost the two most important things in any war.

hunks.baseline: That was also why the small and mid-sized sects of Shanxi Province, which had only been watching which way the wind blew in the war between two powers, had sent reinforcements.
hunks.sol: That was also why the small and mid-sized sects of Shanxi Province, which had been watching the war between the two great powers from the sidelines, had sent reinforcements.

hunks.baseline: Fifteen hundred martial artists would clash at the same hour on the same day.
hunks.sol: Fifteen hundred martial artists would clash on the same day, at the same hour.

hunks.baseline: It would be a hellish fight in which they killed and were killed.
hunks.sol: It would be a hellish battle of killing and being killed.

hunks.baseline: “No one here can guarantee whether they will live or die. However…”
hunks.sol: “No one here can say whether they will live or die. However…”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s flashing eyes took them all in.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s gleaming eyes swept over them all.

hunks.baseline: “We will surely win.”
hunks.sol: “We will prevail.”

hunks.baseline: The next moment.
hunks.sol: Then—

hunks.baseline: A roar burst out, loud enough to leave my ears ringing. With the mood at its height, Jin Wikyung stood towering like a giant.
hunks.sol: A roar erupted, loud enough to leave my ears ringing. As the fervor reached its peak, Jin Wikyung towered above them like a giant.

hunks.baseline: “Survival of the fittest! Fight with your lives on the line, and survive!”
hunks.sol: “Survival of the fittest! Put your lives on the line, fight, and survive!”

hunks.baseline: The cheering went on for a long time afterward.
hunks.sol: The cheering continued for a long time.

hunks.baseline: The five hundred troops were divided into vanguard, center, and rear guard. Most of the core fighting strength had been placed in the vanguard and the center, so the rear I’d been given had only a few dozen martial artists.
hunks.sol: Our five hundred troops were divided into a vanguard, center, and rear guard. Most of our core fighting strength had been assigned to the vanguard and center, so the rear guard under my command consisted of only a few dozen martial artists.

hunks.baseline: Some of the faces were fairly familiar.
hunks.sol: There were some familiar faces among them.

hunks.baseline: They were members of the reconnaissance squad. Half pleased and half puzzled, I asked,
hunks.sol: They were members of the reconnaissance squad. Half glad and half puzzled, I asked, “Why are you guys here? Weren’t you at Medicine King Hall?”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you guys here? Weren’t you at Medicine King Hall?”

hunks.baseline: “This is a battle with the fate of our family at stake. We can’t sit it out just because we’re a little injured.”
hunks.sol: “This battle will decide the fate of our family. We can’t sit it out over a few injuries.”

hunks.baseline: Last time I’d snuck over to visit, some of them had still had cracked bones in their arms and legs. Murim people really were tough as hell.
hunks.sol: When I’d secretly visited them last time, some had still had cracked bones in their arms and legs. Murim people really were tough as hell.

hunks.baseline: “When we asked to be placed under your command, the higher-ups readily approved it. We’ve been walking around with our chests puffed out ever since that day, haha.”
hunks.sol: “We asked to be placed under your command, and the higher-ups readily approved. We’ve been walking around with our chests puffed out ever since that day. Haha.”

hunks.baseline: I let out a short laugh.
hunks.sol: A short laugh escaped me.

hunks.baseline: I’d spent several days with them on the reconnaissance mission, but I didn’t even know some of their names. Even so, I felt close to them—we’d been through life and death together.
hunks.sol: I’d spent several days with them on the reconnaissance mission, but there were still a few whose names I didn’t know. Even so, I felt close to them. We’d been through life and death together.

hunks.baseline: I smiled at the eight reconnaissance-squad members. Then a thought suddenly struck me.
hunks.sol: I smiled at the eight reconnaissance-squad members. Then a thought struck me.

hunks.baseline: I started counting again from the end, one person at a time. Not counting me, there were eight. Han Yeop had serious injuries, so he obviously couldn’t have come—but Hyuk Mujin had snuck out to join us.
hunks.sol: I started counting again from the end, one by one. There had originally been nine of them, not counting me. Hyuk Mujin and Han Yeop were both seriously injured, so neither should have been here. That meant there should have been seven…

hunks.baseline: Even looking at him, I wasn’t sure it was the same guy. His face was puffed up like a steamed bun, and the skin showing past his clothes was red and blotchy.
hunks.sol: Even while looking straight at him, I couldn’t be sure he was the same guy. His face was swollen like a steamed bun, and every patch of skin showing beyond his clothes was red and blotchy.

hunks.baseline: He was right. There was only one rude bastard on the reconnaissance squad.
hunks.sol: He was right. There was only one rude bastard like this on the reconnaissance squad.

hunks.baseline: “Can’t you recognize my face anymore?”
hunks.sol: “You can’t even recognize my face anymore?”

hunks.baseline: No. Before that—why was this bastard here?
hunks.sol: No, more importantly, why was this bastard here?

hunks.baseline: He added,
“They didn’t take me, though.”
hunks.sol: Then he added, “They wouldn’t take me, though.”

hunks.baseline: “I told the physician, and he got angry and asked if I’d gone insane, wanting to die. So I just snuck out.”
hunks.sol: “I told the physician I wanted to go, and he got angry and asked if I’d lost my mind and wanted to die. So I just snuck out.”

hunks.baseline: I spoke seriously.
hunks.sol: I gave him a serious look.

hunks.baseline: “Have you gone insane, wanting to die?”
hunks.sol: “Have you lost your mind? Do you want to die?”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin answered with a look like something had gone sour.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin answered with a sour expression.

hunks.baseline: “Then why did you come here?”
hunks.sol: “Then why did you come?”

hunks.baseline: “Your face looks like it’s about to burst.”
hunks.sol: “Your face looks ready to burst.”

hunks.baseline: “The swelling is going down. My internal injuries have all healed, so there’s no problem.”
hunks.sol: “The swelling is going down. My internal injuries are completely healed, so there’s no problem.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin suddenly bent forward at the waist. Startled, I shouted,
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin suddenly doubled over. Startled, I shouted, “Hey! What’s wrong?”

hunks.baseline: “Hey! What’s wrong?”
“Sometimes my chest hurts whenever I breathe… Ah, it’s fine now.”
hunks.sol: “Sometimes my chest hurts when I breathe… Ah, it’s fine now.”

hunks.baseline: As I stood there speechless, Hyuk Mujin said,
hunks.sol: As I stood there speechless, Hyuk Mujin continued.

hunks.baseline: *Logout. Logout is urgent.*
hunks.sol: *Logout. I need to log out as soon as possible.*

hunks.baseline: Winter night came early. After the sun went down, we walked for who knew how long, and only after we entered a wide basin did the order come to prepare camp.
hunks.sol: Night came early in winter. The sun went down, and after we had walked for who knew how long, the order to make camp finally came once we entered a wide basin.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin groaned. Since he clearly wasn’t fully recovered, the march seemed to be too much for him.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin groaned. He clearly hadn’t fully recovered, and the march seemed to be taking its toll.

hunks.baseline: “It’s not too late. Want to turn back even now?”
hunks.sol: “It’s not too late. Want to turn back?”

hunks.baseline: “You’re mistaken. Does Hyuk Mujin the man look like someone who’d get tired from walking a mere half day?”
hunks.sol: “You’re imagining things. Does Hyuk Mujin, a man among men, look like someone who’d get tired after walking for a mere half day?”

hunks.baseline: “Then go help the others prepare camp.”
hunks.sol: “Then go help the others set up camp.”

hunks.baseline: At that moment, Hyuk Mujin the man snapped his eyes wide and sank to the ground.
hunks.sol: At that moment, Hyuk Mujin, man among men, widened his eyes and sank to the ground.

hunks.baseline: “Ugh, the internal injuries I took from Jopil…”
hunks.sol: “Ugh, the internal injuries Jopil gave me…”

hunks.baseline: *You said your internal injuries had healed, you bastard.*
hunks.sol: *You said your internal injuries were completely healed, you bastard.*

hunks.baseline: I was wondering whether I ought to hit him when a voice cut in.
hunks.sol: I was considering whether to hit him when a voice cut in.

hunks.baseline: A massive shadow stretched under the moonlight. Hyuk Mujin cautiously lifted his head to see who it was, then his eyes flew open.
hunks.sol: A massive shadow stretched beneath the moonlight. Hyuk Mujin cautiously raised his head to see who it was, and his eyes flew open.

hunks.baseline: “Gasp, Lesser Family Head!”
hunks.sol: “Gasp! Lesser Family Head!”

hunks.baseline: The next moment, Hyuk Mujin sprang to his feet like lightning and stood at attention. Jin Wikyung burst out laughing.
hunks.sol: The next moment, Hyuk Mujin shot to his feet like lightning and stood at attention. Jin Wikyung burst out laughing.

hunks.baseline: “You still don’t look fully recovered. Lie back down. Ah, the internal injuries do seem fully healed. I’ll vouch for that.”
hunks.sol: “You still don’t look fully recovered. Stay down. Ah, but your internal injuries do seem completely healed. I’ll vouch for that.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung gave the flustered Hyuk Mujin’s shoulder a light pat, then turned to me.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung lightly patted the flustered Hyuk Mujin on the shoulder, then turned to me.

hunks.baseline: I followed Jin Wikyung to a secluded corner. He spoke first.
hunks.sol: I followed him to a secluded corner. He spoke first.

hunks.baseline: “How’s your condition?”
hunks.sol: “How are you feeling?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s good.”
hunks.sol: “Good.”

hunks.baseline: I’d gotten full use out of the level-up. My body had recovered at a terrifying speed, and distributing my points had made it even stronger.
hunks.sol: I’d reaped the full benefits of leveling up. My body had recovered at a terrifying speed, and allocating my points had made it even stronger.

hunks.baseline: The problem was something else.
hunks.sol: The problem lay elsewhere.

hunks.baseline: No, it was going up. Really, by about a rat dropping. Little by little. Very, very little.
hunks.sol: No, it was going up. By about a rat dropping’s worth. Little by little. Very, very little.

hunks.baseline: At this rate, I couldn’t guarantee I’d be able to log out before the fighting started.
hunks.sol: At this rate, there was no guarantee I’d be able to log out before the fighting began.

hunks.baseline: *If it stayed like this, I mean.*
hunks.sol: *At least, not if things kept going like this.*

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung showing up now was convenient. I brought up what I’d been thinking for a while.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s arrival was perfect timing. I brought up the idea I’d been mulling over.

hunks.baseline: His eyes went round at how bluntly I’d come out with it.
hunks.sol: His eyes widened at my blunt request.

hunks.baseline: The corners of Jin Wikyung’s eyes trembled. He looked like a wave of emotion was running through his whole body.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s eyes trembled. He seemed overcome with emotion.

hunks.baseline: The reason I was putting on this unconvincing act was Fame. If I went out on even a reconnaissance mission and distinguished myself, Fame would come in.
hunks.sol: The reason I was putting on this unconvincing act was Fame. If I went out on even a reconnaissance mission and distinguished myself, I would gain more Fame.

hunks.baseline: It would be even better if I ran into a reconnaissance unit from the Mount Heng Sword Sect. Not only would that be excellent EXP, I’d be able to fill all the Fame I had left.
hunks.sol: Even better if I ran into a reconnaissance unit from the Mount Heng Sword Sect. Not only would they be excellent EXP, they might give me enough Fame to reach five hundred.

hunks.baseline: *Once the real battle starts, it’s over.*
hunks.sol: *Once the real battle started, I was done for.*

hunks.baseline: I had to log out, and fast, before then. I spoke in a voice full of resolve.
hunks.sol: I had to log out before then, and fast. I spoke with determination.

hunks.baseline: “How could you have thought of something so admirable? Thank you, my youngest brother.”
hunks.sol: “How did you come to have such an admirable thought? Thank you, youngest.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung wiped the damp corners of his eyes with his sleeve and went on.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung wiped the damp corners of his eyes with his sleeve, then continued.

hunks.baseline: “Then a reconnaissance mission for me, please?”
hunks.sol: “Then please give me a reconnaissance mission—what?”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll take the sentiment. You guard the rear as you are now.”
hunks.sol: “I appreciate the thought. Keep guarding the rear as you are now.”

hunks.baseline: I barely held down the urge to grab him by the collar and shake him.
hunks.sol: I barely suppressed the urge to grab him by the collar and shake him.

hunks.baseline: “This is a battle with our family’s fate at stake. Do you think I wouldn’t have accounted for something like that?”
hunks.sol: “This battle will decide our family’s fate. Do you think I wouldn’t have accounted for something like that?”

hunks.baseline: “Might there not be a one-in-ten-thousand chance we missed something?”
hunks.sol: “Couldn’t there be a one-in-ten-thousand chance that something was overlooked?”

hunks.baseline: Nothing was going my way. If I really failed to fill my Fame at this rate? Then I’d have to fight a large-scale battle with fifteen hundred people committed.
hunks.sol: Nothing was going my way. What if I really failed to fill the rest of my Fame? Then I’d have to fight in a massive battle involving fifteen hundred people.

hunks.baseline: His voice was heavy and lonely. At the sudden change in mood, I kept quiet and listened.
hunks.sol: His voice was heavy and lonely. At the sudden change in mood, I fell silent and listened.

hunks.baseline: “Your mission is graver than anyone else’s among us.”
hunks.sol: “Your mission is more important than anyone else’s.”

hunks.baseline: “What’s my mission?”
hunks.sol: “What is my mission?”

hunks.baseline: After letting it hang for a long time, he forced out a single word.
hunks.sol: After a long pause, he forced out a single word.

hunks.baseline: “Survive however you can. If our family loses, run without looking back.”
hunks.sol: “Survive, no matter what it takes. If our family loses, run without looking back.”

hunks.baseline: “If the roots live, the tree will grow again. Second Brother and you could become better roots than I.”
hunks.sol: “As long as the roots live, the tree can grow again. You and your second brother could become better roots than I ever could.”

hunks.baseline: His voice and eyes hit home with more seriousness than ever before.
hunks.sol: There was a gravity in his voice and gaze that I had never felt before.

hunks.baseline: The palm resting on my shoulder slid slowly down. I stared after Jin Wikyung’s departing back, unable to look away.
hunks.sol: The hand on my shoulder slowly slipped away. I stared after Jin Wikyung as he left, unable to look away.
